prose: Thomas Gorence is THE Paranoid American, a conspiratorial media mogul of sorts. In tonight's live episode we will get to know him better, while exploring the efficacy and enjoyability of communicating through the comic book medium. Along the way, we'll dip into dialogue on his innovations with AI art, his experiences and thoughts on Freemasonry, and if he's got any juicy revelations to share about the esoteric knowledge preserved by secret societies.
